List the versions of a dataset

Source: R/history.R
store_history.Rd

The current version and the earlier versions kept in the primary's history (see "History" in store_write()), with the time each was written and replaced, its size, and whether all its files are still stored. Reads _history.parquet of the primary and checks that the files exist; no data file is opened.

Usage

store_history(st, dataset)

Arguments

st

A store connection made by store_connect().

dataset

The dataset's full name, or its last part when that is unique. A dataset that was deleted but whose history was kept can be named by its full name.

Value

A tibble, one row per version, the current one first and then by time of replacement, latest first: version, current (logical), written (when its newest file was written), replaced (when a later version replaced it; NA for the current one), n_files, rows, bytes and complete (TRUE when every file of the version is still stored). Times are shown in the session's time zone. Such a version can be read with store_read(version = ).

See also

store_prune().

Examples

root <- file.path(tempdir(), "rcs-example-history")
store_create(file.path(root, "primary"), history = TRUE)
#> ✔ Created an empty store in
#>   C:/Users/EB2/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmp6hCb4K/rcs-example-history/primary.
st <- store_connect(file.path(root, "primary"))
sales <- rcs_sim_table(100, seed = 1)
store_write(st, sales, "sales/daily",
  title = "Daily sales", description = "Simulated daily sales."
)
#> ℹ Writing "sales/daily": 100 rows in 1 file.
#> ✔ primary  C:/Users/EB2/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmp6hCb4K/rcs-example-history/primary  1/1
#>   files sent  13.7 kB  0.2s
#> ✔ MD5 identical for 1 file in 1 location. Catalogs updated.
sales$qty <- sales$qty + 1L
store_write(st, sales, "sales/daily",
  title = "Daily sales", description = "Simulated daily sales.",
  mode = "replace"
)
#> ℹ Replacing "sales/daily": 100 rows in 1 file.
#> ✔ primary  C:/Users/EB2/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmp6hCb4K/rcs-example-history/primary  1/1
#>   files sent  13.7 kB  0.2s
#> ✔ MD5 identical for 1 file in 1 location. Catalogs updated.
store_history(st, "sales/daily")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   version    current written             replaced            n_files  rows bytes
#>   <chr>      <lgl>   <dttm>              <dttm>                <int> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 e359aee05… TRUE    2026-11-21 16:55:18 NA                        1   100 13733
#> 2 9eda87d6a… FALSE   2026-11-21 16:55:18 2026-11-21 16:55:18       1   100 13733
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: complete <lgl>
unlink(root, recursive = TRUE)
